text: Good evening, I am very sorry to trouble you at this hour. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she is 8. She keeps saying the light hurts her eyes. She's got her hand over her face and asked me to switch the big light off, even the hall light bothered her. Also, and I only worked this out when I sat down and thought about it, she hasn't been for a wee at all since breakfast. That's well over 12 hours now. Her parents are away until Sunday. I don't want to waste anyone's time but I'm not sure what to do for the best. Apologies again.
